protocol.cost_contract: capped per-vehicle arrival time + 0.05 command variation; failures, collisions, aborts and timeouts are retained
protocol.observation_contract: same observed kinematics, executed previous command, decision index, declared actuator class and command-history interval

forecast_bank_contract.hash_covers: ordered names plus executed little-endian float64 tape bytes

evidence_execution.sharing: one measured packet per exact state and full executed-command history within a case
evidence_execution.cache_cost: attribute original packet cost to each selector; count actual unique builds separately
evidence_execution.confidence: sigmoid(nominal paired team-cost gain / 0.05 seconds); zero if incomplete
evidence_execution.raw_path_semantics: 33 paired baseline/raw-proposal forecasts, requiring up to 66 kernel calls
evidence_execution.deadline_semantics: cooperative cutoff; discard late result and return baseline; not a hard wall-time cap

design.pooled_exact_binomial_target: marginal over the frozen uniform mixture
design.fixed_cell_results: secondary descriptive only; never pooled as IID repetitions

comparison_scope.proposed_candidate_set: projected/repaired search over at most 28 commands
comparison_scope.limitation: Candidate sets differ: this study compares complete deployed selectors, not only their scalar admission criteria.

contract.pre_adoption_failure: retain all costs and failure flags; exclude only from adoption denominator
contract.zero_adoption_equality: require equality only when candidate and baseline both succeed
contract.failed_baseline: retain capped costs; conservatively mark harm; relative improvement unassessable
contract.ranking: unchanged risk/gain/adoption order among useful methods with zero method and baseline failures
contract.timeout: any recorded evidence timeout remains a failure, even if baseline fallback finishes
contract.uncertainty: unchanged V39 allocation and bounds; no new risk certificate
